A PRACTICAL START

Before we
build anything.

Do I need a brand-new Salesforce implementation?+

Not necessarily. The first conversation is about your goals and what is getting in the way. The appropriate next step might be improving the existing setup, simplifying a process or helping your team use what is already there.

Who is this work for?+

Denizard Consulting focuses on nonprofit and SaaS teams looking for support with Salesforce, CRM operations, reporting and adoption.

What should I bring to the first conversation?+

A short description of the problem, who it affects, your current systems and what a better outcome would look like. There is no need to share login credentials or sensitive records.

How are scope and pricing decided?+

Start by discussing your priorities. The scope, deliverables, timing and commercial terms should be agreed before an engagement begins.
